headline: 100 Taka meal shop: ‘Viral Mizan’s’ hotel evicted again
summary: The popular eatery known for serving beef and rice for 100 Taka has been demolished by authorities.
details: The eatery run by 'Viral Mizan', which gained popularity for offering beef and rice meals for 100 Taka, has been evicted again.
Authorities carried out the demolition of the temporary structure to clear the area.
The shop had previously been a point of interest on social media due to its affordable pricing for low-income earners.
The eviction marks a repeat occurrence for the business, which had struggled to maintain a permanent location.

headline: Biman Bangladesh stops screening films 'Lalsalu' and 'Chitra Nodir Pare'
summary: The national airline has decided to remove two acclaimed films by director Tanvir Mokammel from its in-flight entertainment system.
details: Biman Bangladesh Airlines has stopped screening the films 'Lalsalu' and 'Chitra Nodir Pare' on its flights. These movies, directed by Tanvir Mokammel, had been shown on the airline's flights for a long time.
The airline notified the relevant distribution company about the decision to stop the screenings. The move has sparked questions and debate on social media regarding the reasons behind the removal.
Director and producer Tanvir Mokammel has also addressed the situation through a post on Facebook, expressing his thoughts on the matter.
caption:
